rows.basis: The money-flow model records Vistra's FY2025 PPAs with named hyperscalers: AWS for up to 1,200 MW at Comanche Peak (a contract ceiling, delivery from 2027), Meta for more than 2,600 MW across its PJM nuclear fleet (an aggregate across plants, including uprates), and a 200 MW AWS solar PPA at Oak Hill. FY2025 growth and development capex of $1,126M (within the $2,752M total, which includes nuclear fuel and LTSA prepayments) is not split by project or customer, so no AI amount can be attributed. The pack contains no company statement that ties a capex amount to these projects.
